title: Resolve declared built-in executor for imported Skills
goal: Make the supported text.normalize executor declaration in Skill.md resolve for imported Skill IDs while keeping unregistered executor names fail-closed.
context: SkillMarkdownStore persists the Skill.md executor field as metadata, but SkillRuntime.resolveExecutor previously ignored it and only resolved a host-registered executor by Skill ID, the canonical text.normalize ID, or an explicit allowlisted moduleID. Imported Skills declaring executor=text.normalize were therefore undispatchable. This task supports only that explicit built-in alias and keeps unknown executor names unavailable.
forbidden_changes: Do not dynamically load or instantiate arbitrary executor names from untrusted Skill.md metadata.
Do not change policy, capability grants, ModuleRuntime behavior, UI, or Xcode project files.
Do not claim full Skill-to-Tool integration from support for this one built-in executor.
acceptance_criteria: A Skill manifest with metadata executor=text.normalize resolves the built-in normalizer even when its Skill ID differs, provided both schema identifiers match the canonical normalization contract.
A host-registered per-Skill executor takes precedence over any metadata alias.
Unknown executor names and schema-mismatched normalization aliases remain unavailable and fail closed.
Regression tests cover execution and verification of the imported Skill ID, host executor precedence, unknown executor metadata, and schema mismatch.
verification: Confirm Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head.
recovery: Revert the single task commit if the regression test or required CI fails; keep Issue #347 open for the remaining module/tool execution and verification work.
